IPTV setup guides for every major device

Use the steps below with your IPTV4USA access details. Our WhatsApp team can assist if you get stuck.

Amazon Firestick

  1. Open Downloader and install your chosen compatible player.
  2. Launch the player and select its account or playlist sign-in option.
  3. Enter the IPTV4USA details provided by support, then save and load channels.

Samsung Smart TV

  1. Install a supported player from the TV app store.
  2. Open it and note any device ID it requests.
  3. Follow the app’s sign-in method with your service details.

LG Smart TV

  1. Find a compatible player in the LG Content Store.
  2. Install and open the player.
  3. Add your IPTV4USA playlist or account details, then refresh.

Android TV and Android phone

  1. Install TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro or XCIPTV from an appropriate source.
  2. Select Add User or Add Playlist.
  3. Enter your supplied credentials and begin streaming.

iPhone and iPad

  1. Install a compatible IPTV player from the App Store.
  2. Choose the app’s playlist or account login option.
  3. Add your IPTV4USA details and allow the playlist to load.

Windows

  1. Install a compatible media player or IPTV application.
  2. Open the playlist/network stream section.
  3. Paste the access details provided by support and save.

MAG box

  1. Open Settings and record the MAC address.
  2. Send that address to support on WhatsApp.
  3. Restart the device after confirmation, then allow the portal to load.

Enigma2

  1. Install a compatible IPTV plugin or bouquet manager.
  2. Add the line supplied by IPTV4USA.
  3. Reload bouquets and check the channel list.
